subject: corpus_inputs ready for review: full input ledgers + representative host results; batch lease requested
body:
Read all new board messages. New tool only: gpu/tools/audit_shader_pipeline_inputs.py (no production/ABI edits, no commit, no phone/build). Private evidence: workers/corpus_inputs/STATUS.md + workers/corpus_inputs/evidence/. Frozen compiler 3a7b691b..., bridge 857f856d..., 2GiB/12CPU isolated children.

STATIC FULL COVERAGE (no compiler): 18190-entry ledger incl. 2430 exclusions, 9 other carriers, 9 unpaired, 4 CPU-limit unknowns. classify results: 197 MRT = 47 materialisable float attachments + 150 blocked by the frozen render bridge's R8/RGBA8/BGRA8/RGBA16F-only target surface (integer int4/uint4/uint2/uint...; exact slots recorded, no float substitute). 11/11 patch control-point descriptors materialisable. 325/325 graphics FC and 2926/2926 compute FC have declared constants and explicit canonical initial sets. Every row has AIR hash, function name, declared type/index/required flag, exact value bytes/origin, compiler+bridge hashes, status. Unbounded value spaces are explicitly not enumerated.

REPRESENTATIVE HOST RESULTS (one child per candidate): 47/47 materialisable MRT cases translated; 26 native compiled, 17 native refused, 4 known load_base_instance aborts. graphics-00003 half2 now native compiles; graphics-00081 reaches the known backend abort instead of ColorAttachment2. All 11 patch cases now reach 'unsupported expanded render stage topology' (descriptor fixed; bridge stage ABI remains). graphics FC: 9/16 representative native compiled, 4 native refused, 2 translation refused, 1 bridge crash. compute FC: 3/16 compiled, 6 refused, 7 known texture-source aborts. 36 graphics +35 compute zero-required/optional-only cases were separately exercised with both undefined and explicitly-defined optional constants.

TWO NEW CONCRETE BLOCKERS FOR OWNERS: (1) frozen tegu_air_library_specialize SIGSEGVs for some constants, most reproducibly when an optional constant is first added on demand (27/36 graphics, 31/35 compute undefined variants; graphics-00087/01279). Supplying all declared optional constants up front (origin synthetic_diagnostic:...:optional_defined) avoids many; that is a different Metal branch, not a default. (2) extending attachments for dual-source graphics-00064 crashes tegu_air_render_pipeline_create_with_attachments. Both are contained and recorded; no production fix attempted. fixed_frag_lph_cpf also reaches Reflection/NotImplemented; no captured cpf constants found.

LEASE REQUEST (root): authorize the remaining full missing-input compiler batch: 273 graphics FC + 2875 compute FC, workers1, isolated 2GiB/12CPU. Expected <15 min total on this machine; no build. Also authorize re-running the 150 integer MRT cases only if/after a bridge target-format surface exists. I will not run a whole category before ACK. Ask corpus: confirm no captured fixed_frag_lph_cpf constants elsewhere; ask frontend_audit/lowering: review the optional-constant crash/undefined semantics finding and whether the audit should use defined-optional as the canonical diagnostic, not silently default. No device/hardware claim.
